title: Unearned betrayal versus an earned relationship break

relationships.status: Committed partners who protect each other

finding.title: Marisol reverses her promise to protect Ana
finding.summary: Marisol makes an explicit promise never to give Vale evidence against Ana, then does exactly that without an on-page relationship change.
finding.question: Is Marisol's reversal of her promise to Ana intentional at this point?
finding.conflicting_fact_a: Marisol promises never to give Vale evidence against Ana.
finding.conflicting_fact_b: Marisol hands Vale Ana's drive and identifies it as everything he needs.
finding.inference_explanation: No current scene changes their relationship or Marisol's stated commitment.

evidence.quote: No matter what happens, I will never give Vale evidence against you.
Marisol hands Vale Ana's evidence drive.
